equivalentSurvivor.reason: rejoin marks live=false before close; the retained callback checks live and cannot reset the episode. Removing its unsubscribe changes listener cleanup, not observed recovery behavior. No functional mutation is counted as killed without a failed assertion.

mutations.outOfManifestTransientProbe: HP16 temporarily routes the existing member binder arm through joinMember; the original binder is restored byte-for-byte. No out-of-manifest product change is committed.

sensitiveAnalysis.authority: Consumer applies only server-offered state and confirms exactly offered receipts; bound host/member joins still bypass joinMember. No new authority or server port activation.
sensitiveAnalysis.privacy: Fixed recovery message reveals no payload or receipt details. CF-S-1 stays open; HTTP projection unchanged.
sensitiveAnalysis.replay: G1 heardAt watermark, ordered settlement, replacement EMPTY fold and cut marking remain pinned.
sensitiveAnalysis.idempotency: Idempotent settlement release; exactly two quiet retries per mounted identity until qualified reset.
sensitiveAnalysis.concurrency: Per-mounted-hook episode spans socket identities, ignores stale callbacks, clears timers on disposal, and releases before a confirmation-triggered microtask unmount.

acceptedResiduals: Pre-H legacy servers have no healthy application confirmation; budget resets on remount only.
Same-key effect rerun can bind against a spent budget; notice persists until healthy confirmation or reload.
Only quiet-window retries are bounded; non-quiet recovery-required signals remain outside this finite policy.
No receipt-port installation and no durable cross-route retry cap.
